productRanking.title: Shop ranking
productRanking.sub: The order products show in on your own shop: category pages, collections and "New in". This is not Google; Google ranking is in Website › SEO.

what.title: What counts, and how much
what.sub: Every product gets a score from 0 to 100 from five things. Move the sliders to decide how much each counts; the order on the right follows at once. Nothing goes live until you press "Save this order". A sold-out size lowers the score by itself.

productRanking.saved: The new order is on the shop
productRanking.neverSaved: No order saved yet: the shop still uses the order it had.
productRanking.tryNote: You are trying other weights. Nothing is saved until you press "Save this order".
productRanking.readOnly: You can see the ranking. Changing it needs the permission to change products.

live.title: Order on the shop
live.sub: ▲▼ = places moved since the last saved order. "Top" keeps a product above everything (good for a launch); "Down" sends it to the end. Pins take effect when you save the order.

productRanking.empty: No product is live on the shop yet.

err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
err.other: Could not save. Please try again.

options.d: How the score is worked out, and whether the new order goes on the shop by itself each night.
options.freshDays: Days a product counts as new
options.freshDaysHelp: Newness fades to 0 at this age.
options.coverDays: Days of stock that count as healthy
options.coverDaysHelp: Stock that lasts this long at the last 30 days' sales speed gets the full stock score.
options.autoApply: Put the new order on the shop every night by itself
options.autoApplyHelp: Off: the scores update every night but the order changes only when you press "Save this order".
options.readOnly: You can see these. Changing them needs the permission to change products.

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. The page is read again.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the permission for this.
